say:0:1211201001:0.text: Cross the bridge, head west, and you'll see the Ashen Bay. Stay alert.
say:0:1211201001:0.source_cn: 过桥往西就是灰烬湾，警惕起来。
say:0:1211201001:0.male: Cross the bridge, head west, and you'll see the Ashen Bay. Stay alert.
say:0:1211201001:0.female: Cross the bridge, head west, and you'll see the Ashen Bay. Stay alert.

say:1:1211201002:0.text: The Ashen Bay leads directly to the back of the Dead Tide Fleet. They'll have their defenses up.
say:1:1211201002:0.source_cn: 灰烬湾直通死潮舰队后方，他们一定有所防卫。
say:1:1211201002:0.male: The Ashen Bay leads directly to the back of the Dead Tide Fleet. They'll have their defenses up.
say:1:1211201002:0.female: The Ashen Bay leads directly to the back of the Dead Tide Fleet. They'll have their defenses up.
